overview: 66 official Qs (2008, 2017, 2019, 2025). GSDP and sectoral shares (16), central assistance incl. AP Reorganisation Act (14) and growth/structure incl. Vision documents (12) lead; AP plan expenditure (7) was a 2008 favourite; tax, non-tax, debt, external projects and budget are small; interest payments not yet asked. Mostly one-liners (44 + 15 without printed options), 3 statement, 2 matching, 2 negative. Facts asked: dated AP shares and growth rates, APRA sections, FC awards to AP, project–funder pairs.

possibility.angle: Structure and growth of AP economy – growth rates, plan priorities, Vision 2020/2029, district workforce
possibility.what_they_ask: growth rate of a named year, only state with double-digit growth (2015-16), Vision 2020 12% target, Sunrise AP goal years, AP Plan IV priority (electricity), district with most cultivators/labourers, AP vs Telangana share of national GDP

agency estimating state income (DES), methods used, base year, number of sectors, sector shares of GVA (agri ~32–36%, industry ~22–23%, services ~40–46%), AP's GSDP rank and growth rank, best district GDDP, sector growth matching
PCI of a year, Vision 2029 PCI target (Rs 9.61 lakh), AP PCI vs India PCI comparison
sales-tax share of own tax revenue (~73% in 2016-17 RE), stamp duty receipts, largest own non-tax source (mines and minerals)

possibility.angle: AP state expenditure and plan outlays
possibility.what_they_ask: head with the highest share in a plan (Tenth = irrigation), small heads (industry ~5%, communications ~5%), First Plan outlay, capex share < 15% (2016-21), CFMS
public debt as % of GSDP in a budget year (34.14% BE 2024-25)

natural targets, judged from the debt and expenditure items: interest as share of revenue receipts or revenue expenditure, committed expenditure (salaries + pensions + interest), BE vs RE figure of a named year

possibility.angle: Central assistance – FC awards to AP, APRA 2014 provisions, special category, central institutes
possibility.what_they_ask: AP share in central taxes (14th FC 4.305%), revenue-deficit grant Rs 22,113 cr, SDRF amount, APRA section for resource gap/backward districts, capital assistance, institute–location matching, Amaravati rail line facts
funder of a named AP project (SAPAP–UNDP, APIIATP–World Bank, Amaravati–World Bank + ADB), purpose for which states may borrow from bilateral agencies
distinct AP practice (separate agriculture budget), agri-budget 2014-15 loan waiver Rs 5,000 cr, Feb 2019 vote-on-account, AgriGold allocation

traps.trap: [Order] Rotates the three AP sector shares
traps.spot: Options are the same three numbers in different order
traps.fix: AP order is services > agriculture > industry; agriculture ~1/3, industry ~1/5–1/4

traps.trap: [India vs AP] Applies the all-India trend to AP
traps.spot: Statements that agriculture is declining or that India's figure is higher
traps.fix: Residual AP is more agrarian; agriculture's GVA share rose after bifurcation (23% → 34.4%); AP PCI is above India's
traps.pyq: 2011-12 to 2016-17 → 'agriculture sector has shown steady improvement' [mains-2017-paper3#100]; India PCI 2023-24 lower than AP's → both true [mains-2025-paper2#55]

traps.fix: s.46(2) resource gap of residual AP; s.46(3) backward-district package; s.90 Polavaram; s.94 tax incentives and capital support
traps.pyq: Backward districts → Section 46(3) [prelims-2019#49]; resource shortage → Section 46(2) [mains-2019-paper1#98]

traps.trap: [Share type] Vertical devolution confused with AP's horizontal share
traps.spot: Options of a few % for AP alongside 42% talk
traps.fix: 42% is the states' pool (14th FC); AP's share of that pool is 4.305%
traps.pyq: AP share in central taxes (14th FC) → 4.305% [prelims-2017#139]

traps.trap: [Funder] Swaps the external agency for an AP project
traps.spot: Options pair World Bank with IMF/ADB/JICA/EC
traps.fix: Amaravati Phase-I = World Bank + ADB; APIIATP = World Bank; SAPAP = UNDP; IMF does not fund projects
traps.pyq: Amaravati → World Bank and ADB [mains-2025-paper2#66]; APIIATP → World Bank [mains-2025-paper2#67]

traps.trap: [Basically] Reads 'basically an economy of' as output share
traps.fix: Answer by employment dependence – agriculture – even when services lead GSDP
traps.pyq: AP economy is basically an economy of → Agriculture sector [group2-2008-paper3#115]

traps.trap: [Detail] Alters one number in a project description
traps.spot: Negative 'not correct' list of project facts
traps.fix: Check length, cost, districts and timeline separately; Amaravati line timeline is 4 years
traps.pyq: 'Timeline of the project is 6 years' is not correct [mains-2025-paper2#64]

traps.trap: [Plan] Swaps the priority sector of an AP plan
traps.spot: Irrigation vs power vs social sector
traps.fix: AP Plans I–III irrigation, IV electricity, X irrigation again
traps.pyq: Fourth Plan → Electricity [mains-2017-paper3#145]; Tenth Plan → Irrigation [group2-2008-paper3#103]

techniques.name: [Sector order] Rank-then-match
techniques.how: Before reading numbers, write the AP order services > agriculture > industry; discard every option breaking it, then match the year.
techniques.example: 2022-23 GVA: options with industry 36% or agriculture 26% fall; only Agri 36.19 / Ind 23.36 / Serv 40.45 keeps the order [mains-2025-paper2#58]

techniques.name: [Vintage] Read the estimate tag
techniques.how: Note year, AE/RE/BE, current vs constant prices; pick the figure of that vintage only.
techniques.example: Public debt % of GSDP, BE 2024-25 → 34.14% (RE is higher) [mains-2025-paper2#62]

techniques.name: [Lowest anchor] Anchor the extreme in growth matching
techniques.how: In sector–growth matching fix the lowest rate (usually agriculture in a weak year) and the highest, then the middle falls into place.
techniques.example: AP AE 2023-24 sector growth match → a-C, b-B, c-A [mains-2025-paper2#54]

techniques.name: [APRA] Section map
techniques.how: Keep a 4-line map of APRA: s.46 finance (2 resource gap, 3 backward areas), s.90 Polavaram, s.93/13th Schedule institutions, s.94 incentives/capital.

techniques.name: [Distinctive] 'One of the few states' test
techniques.how: Universal practices (capital budget, performance budget) cannot be the answer; pick the AP-specific one.
techniques.example: AP is one of the few states with an Agriculture budget [mains-2017-paper3#149]

techniques.name: [Location] Institute–city lock
techniques.how: Fix one certain pair (AIIMS Mangalagiri / IIM Visakhapatnam / IIT Tirupati) and reject codes that break it.
techniques.example: APRA institutes matching → a-ii, b-v, c-iv, d-i, e-iii [mains-2025-paper2#63]

confusions.remember: Output led by services; jobs (~55%) by agriculture
2020: 12% growth; 2029: best state, PCI Rs 9.61 lakh; global destination by 2050
Pool for all states vs AP's slice
Total vs per head – read the measure
Sales tax/VAT vs mines and minerals
UNDP pilot preceded the World Bank programme
Feb 2019 AP budget was a vote on account (pre-election)

anchors: State income estimated by the Directorate of Economics and Statistics
AP the only state with double-digit growth in 2015-16; 1st in GSDP growth 2017-18
AP GSDP rank 7th (2018); Krishna best district GDDP 2017-18
Vision 2020 growth target 12%; Vision 2029 PCI Rs 9.61 lakh
14th FC: AP share 4.305%; revenue-deficit grant Rs 22,113 crore; SDRF Rs 2,492 crore
APRA 2014: s.46(2) resource gap, s.46(3) backward districts, s.90 Polavaram, s.94 incentives
Sales tax ~73% of own tax revenue (2016-17 RE); stamps and registration Rs 3,476 crore (2016-17)
Capital expenditure < 15% of total expenditure in 2016-21
Amaravati Phase-I: World Bank + ADB; APIIATP: World Bank; SAPAP: UNDP
AP agri-budget 2014-15: Rs 5,000 crore loan waiver
AP Plan priorities: IV electricity; X irrigation
checklist: Sector-share item? Apply services > agriculture > industry before numbers.
Number item? Lock year, AE/RE/BE and current vs constant prices.
Comparison with India? Remember AP is more agrarian and has higher PCI.
APRA item? Recall the section map before options.
FC item? Separate vertical pool from AP's horizontal share and the Commission number.
Project item? Name the funder pair; IMF never funds projects.
